events.title: Rise of Chi Demo v1.0
events.summary: The final major update for the Rise of Chi demo is here!This will be the final demo build before the full release in November.What’s improvedNumerous bug fixes and stability improvementsGameplay and combat polishUI and control improvementsBetter overall balancing and pacingAdditional quality-of-life improvements throughout the adventureThank you to everyone who has played the demo, shared feedback, reported bugs, or wishlisted the game. Your feedback has helped shape Rise of Chi.

events.title: Rise of Chi - Major Demo Update v0.7
events.summary: Major Demo Update v0.7 This update brings major quality-of-life improvements across gameplay, UI, combat, and menus. Objectives are now easier to track, inventory items are easier to consume, map and controls have improved shortcuts, and several issues involving hitboxes, deaths, shops, breakable walls, achievements and navigation have been fixed.The title screen has also been refreshed with animation, and direct access to Settings and Controls.

events.title: 🐔 A Major Demo Update Is Here!
events.summary: The latest Rise of Chi demo update is now live!This update introduces the long-awaited card game, giving you a new challenge and the chance to complete every achievement available in the demo.You’ll also find:• Improved player attacks• Smarter enemy behavior• Bug fixes• Smoother, more polished gameplayJump back in, try the new card game, and let me know what you think!
